top.line: The PrompTugal bulletins: from a text bulletin to twelve presenters on a 3D stage, and movies made by code.

in-short.line: Six versions in two days; code not rendering; live data and voices; a game engine; stories next; filmmakers.

evolution.line: A text bulletin, a hologram, twelve presenters, the split, an explainer, today's version 2 bulletin.

v2.line: A Claude session built 3D puppets on one skeleton: 69 moves, mouth shapes from sound, every frame a function of time.

programmatic.line: 939 frames from a timeline and a fifth of a cent of voice; live data, screenshots and real voices next.

engine.line: A game engine for explaining, now a versioned library preview, latest and v0.1.0; the storyboards revisited.

stories.line: Animated article summaries, Vicky's team, the Swarm, sovereign websites, a morning briefing.

invitation.line: It would be ten times better with filmmakers and storytellers; let's talk.

limits.line: Experiments; the library a preview until reviewed; real voices only with agreement.

sources.line: My thinking and the bulletins repository, read on 21 November 2026.
